{"Author":"ssalazar217 (SteSE)","Name":"EchoXIV","Punchline":"Bidirectional chat translation in Dalamud with auto-failover. / Traducción bidireccional de chat en Dalamud con failover automático.","Description":"EchoXIV is a chat translation tool for FFXIV. It translates both incoming and outgoing chat messages so you can communicate more naturally with players who use other languages.
Key Features:
- Bidirectional chat translation for incoming and outgoing messages.
- Configurable reading and writing languages.
- Multiple translation engines (Google, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, Local AI) with configurable fallback and automatic primary recovery.
- Integrated Dalamud chat window for translated messages.

[Español]
EchoXIV es una herramienta de traducción de chat para FFXIV. Traduce mensajes entrantes y salientes para que puedas comunicarte de forma más natural con jugadores que usan otros idiomas.
Características:
- Traducción bidireccional para mensajes entrantes y salientes.
- Idiomas de lectura y escritura configurables.
- Múltiples motores de traducción (Google, Papago, LibreTranslate, Yandex, IA local) con respaldo configurable y recuperación automática del principal.
- Ventana integrada de Dalamud para mensajes traducidos.","Changelog":"v1.0.2.1:
- Added Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, LibreTranslate, and Yandex translation engines.
- Added configurable translation instances with primary engine selection, ordered fallback, and recovery probing.
- Added per-instance model, API key, temperature, and response token limit settings.
- Added single-request AI romanization with native and Latin-script output in structured JSON.
- Improved romanization support for Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Russian, and Ukrainian.
- Improved translated-chat display for native text, Latin-script text, original messages, and tooltips.
- Unified translation logs with the selected engine, target language, elapsed time, and romanization.
- Added local language detection to skip translation when messages already match the configured target language.
- Added configurable language-detection confidence from 70% to 100%, with an 85% default.
- Added independent translated-window message limits and size-based persistent chat history.
- Added history search and filtering, and made Clear remove only messages currently displayed.
- Added direct settings access from the translated-chat window and an option to control /tl chat status messages.

{"Author":"Bronya Rand","Name":"Things To Do In Eorzea","Punchline":"Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!","Description":"
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.
    ","Changelog":"Introducing Aetheric Flow! 1.0 Release!

Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.

Key Features:
- Adds a clickable teleport link after map coordinates in chat.
- Picks the nearest aetheryte you have attuned in that zone.
- /aftp teleports to the most recent map link for controller players.
- Choose which chat channels are scanned.
- Plenty of customisation options for the links appearance.
- English, Japanese, German and French are all supported.","TestingChangelog":"Things To Do In Eorzea is more than just a simple to-do-list. It's one that automatically monitors what you need to collect, what duties you need to clear, FATEs and more! You can either set it up to track items you need or have it track your clears. Think that's not enough? You can even set yourself up some ridiculous tasks for yourself like doing MINE Bahamut or a whole Savage round without dying/wiping to just simply forcing yourself to play a specific job, or speedrun. There are always things to do in Eorzea. Just get creative!

Unlike other to-do plugins, Things To Do In Eorzea:
1. Auto-tracks your completed dungeons, trials and raids.
2. Auto-tracks your completed FATEs by region, a specific FATE or any FATE in general.
3. Auto-tracks the items in your inventory, making sure you have what you needed to get.
4. Make self-imposed challenges like doing Minstrel's Ballads on MINE difficulty, speedrun a Dungeon, one-shot/no kill, and more.
5. Read objectives in your native language*

   > French is partially broken ATM pending a Dalamud merge.

And you still have your sticky note for whenever you need it.

AI Use: Assist
> AI was used to inquire about translations from English to Japanese to show there was at least an attempt to show that localization is supported. However said translations may not be accurate. Anyone interested may PR or DM me their translated findings for German, Japanese and French if they so please. Thus far:
> - Full English on UI and Objective Display
> - Full Japanese [Claude+Gemini+Google Translate+DeepL+Japanese Dictionary] on UI and Objective Display
> - German only on the Objective Display with partial assistance from XIV community for macros and Claude
> - French only on the Objective DIsplay with assistance from Gemini and Clause
> 
> There was also AI assist for the localization system.","Tags":["to-do,list,track,task,objective,custom,utility,ui,other"],"CategoryTags":["utility","ui","other"],"IsHide":true,"InternalName":"ThingsToDoInEorzea","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.0.0","TestingAssemblyVersion":"1.0.0.0","IsTestingExclusive":true,"RepoUrl":"https://github.com/Bronya-Rand/ThingsToDoInEorzea.git","ApplicableVersion":"any","DalamudApiLevel":15,"TestingDalamudApiLevel":15,"DownloadCount":224,"LastUpdate":1787607241,"DownloadLinkInstall":"https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/Download/ThingsToDoInEorzea?isUpdate=False&isTesting=False&branch=api9&isDip17=True","DownloadLinkUpdate":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/goatcorp/DalamudPlugins/api9/plugins/ThingsToDoInEorzea/latest.zip","DownloadLinkTesting":"https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/Download/ThingsToDoInEorzea?isUpdate=False&isTesting=True&branch=api9&isDip17=True","LoadPriority":0,"ImageUrls":null,"IconUrl":null,"AcceptsFeedback":true,"FeedbackMessage":null,"FeedbackWebhook":null,"_isDip17Plugin":true,"_Dip17Channel":"testing-live"}

{"Author":"Bronya Rand","Name":"ProxyPlayer","Punchline":"Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!","Description":"
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your computer's media playback from within XIV.

Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
Features (depending on your media player):
- Play/Pause
- Next/Previous Track
- Stop
- Progress Bar
- Cover Art Display
- Metadata

ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information.
    ","Changelog":"Introducing Aetheric Flow! 1.0 Release!

Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.

Key Features:
- Adds a clickable teleport link after map coordinates in chat.
- Picks the nearest aetheryte you have attuned in that zone.
- /aftp teleports to the most recent map link for controller players.
- Choose which chat channels are scanned.
- Plenty of customisation options for the links appearance.
- English, Japanese, German and French are all supported.","TestingChangelog":"ProxyPlayer is a plugin that allows users to control what's playing on their PC, whether it be Firefox, Spotify, or any media player from within XIV. No need to Alt-Tab to Play/Pause, just control it within the game.

## Features:
- Metadata support like Title/Cover Art of songs being played
- Support for UWP apps or browsers playing YT Music, Spotify, pretty much any media player or browser communicating on Windows' SMTC (System Media Transport Controls) protocol.
- Play/Pause, Next/Previous
- (On some players) Stop, Shuffle, Repeat, Repeat Once

## Dependency
- ProxyPlayer is dependent on a included project called `ProxyPlayerServer` which serves as a middleman between XIV/Dalamud and Windows. Due to the use of Windows API, this is needed to forward data between Windows and XIV for the plugin to work properly as it needs its own wrapper. 

## How To Test:
1. Build ProxyPlayerServer first and then ProxyServer.
2. Run plugin.

To access the plugin use `/pplayer` or click the DTR on the server info bar.

## AI Disclosure
- AI was only used to provide examples of SMTC controls in C#, thus Assisted.","Tags":["music,proxy,player,media,windows,smtc"],"CategoryTags":["utility","ui","other"],"IsHide":true,"InternalName":"ProxyPlayer","AssemblyVersion":"1.0.0.0","TestingAssemblyVersion":"1.0.0.0","IsTestingExclusive":true,"RepoUrl":"https://github.com/Bronya-Rand/ProxyPlayer.git","ApplicableVersion":"any","DalamudApiLevel":15,"TestingDalamudApiLevel":15,"DownloadCount":74,"LastUpdate":1787607829,"DownloadLinkInstall":"https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/Download/ProxyPlayer?isUpdate=False&isTesting=False&branch=api9&isDip17=True","DownloadLinkUpdate":"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/goatcorp/DalamudPlugins/api9/plugins/ProxyPlayer/latest.zip","DownloadLinkTesting":"https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/Download/ProxyPlayer?isUpdate=False&isTesting=True&branch=api9&isDip17=True","LoadPriority":0,"ImageUrls":null,"IconUrl":null,"AcceptsFeedback":true,"FeedbackMessage":null,"FeedbackWebhook":null,"_isDip17Plugin":true,"_Dip17Channel":"testing-live"}

{"Author":"grittyfrog","Name":"Duty Loot Preview","Punchline":"Preview duty loot before it drops.","Description":"Preview duty loot before it drops.","Changelog":"# InputFlow
Improve the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts.

Supported shortcuts:
- CTRL + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT to jump words
- CTRL + SHIFT + LEFT/RIGHT to select words
- CTRL + BACK/DELETE to delete words
- CTRL/SHIFT + INSERT to copy/paste
- SHIFT + DELETE to cut

Changes:
- LEFT/RIGHT unselects even if the cursor is at the start/end respectively
- LEFT/RIGHT with an active selection unselects and puts the cursor at the beginning/end of the selection","TestingChangelog":"DutyLootPreview is now a standalone plugin instead of a VanillaPlus module (at MidoriKami's request).
